_comment: Offscreen-QPA screen configuration for ps_test_dbusscreenadaptor ONLY.
ps_test_manager_lifecycle is deliberately NOT wired to this fixture:
giving it named screens un-skips four functions of which three then
fail, because the manager's re-emit behaviour for a configfile screen
set has never been settled. The CMakeLists comment beside the target
list carries the detail. Do not add it here without fixing that.
The offscreen platform plugin's default screen is unnamed, so
ScreenIdentity::identifierFor() resolves it to the empty string and every
test that needs a physical id bails out with 'no primary screen available
under offscreen QPA'. Naming the outputs gives those tests a real id, and
the second output makes identifier drift and per-screen removal
observable at all — with one screen the before and after are the same
